description: Token-bucket limiter with 12 constraints including monotonic time and lazy refill.

input.message:
Write a Python class `TokenBucket` implementing rate limiting.
Requirements — ALL must hold:
1. Class named exactly `TokenBucket`.
2. Constructor takes `rate: float` (tokens per second) and `capacity: int`.
3. Raise `ValueError` when rate <= 0 or capacity < 1.
4. `allow(cost: int = 1) -> bool` consumes tokens and returns whether the request is permitted.
5. Refill tokens LAZILY based on elapsed time — do not use a background thread or timer.
6. Use `time.monotonic()`, NOT `time.time()` (a wall-clock jump must not grant free tokens).
7. Never let the bucket exceed `capacity` tokens.
8. Never let the token count go negative.
9. Guard state with a `threading.Lock`.
10. Full type hints on every method.
11. A class docstring explaining the algorithm.
12. Standard library only.
Output one Python code block and nothing else.
